meta.name: Louisiana Story
meta.description:
A young Cajun boy named Alexander Napolean Ulysses Latour (Joseph Boudreaux) spends his time on a Louisiana bayou. 
There he plays, fishes and hunts, worrying only about the alligators which infest its waters. 
The boy's innocent routine changes forever when his father (Lionel Le Blanc) signs a lease agreement with an oil company which brings a derrick into their corner of the bayou.
